title: WebSocket frames: strict decoder for either peer, encoders with minimal lengths
spec: Implement FrameDecoder::next_frame, encode_server_frame and encode_client_frame as the doc comments say, by hand (no WebSocket library; the RFC 6455 section 5.7 examples are in the test). Every length or index taken from received bytes must be checked before it is used to slice or allocate: a hostile peer controls them. Delete the `#[allow(clippy::todo)]` on the stubs. No new dependencies.
